You find the key to the armory, which is located in the cargo hold. 
Dynamite, rifles, shotguns, and handguns are available there. 
Select your weapons from the Call of Cthulhu Rulebook  (page 
401–405), but do not take more than one of each type. Make a 
Luck roll: if successful, you can arm yourself as you wish, return 
to 460; if failed, go to 511.
